a_before_b.rationale: Understanding preference finetuning as a post-training alignment step does not require knowing how to distinguish between information-based and behavior-based failures to choose between RAG and finetuning.

b_before_a.rationale: Meaningfully deciding whether to apply finetuning (as opposed to RAG) requires understanding what finetuning, including preference finetuning, actually does to align model behavior.
